note: Illustrative investor overlay matrix for workflow guidance only. Do not treat as pricing or commitment policy.

overlays.title: Conventional primary occupancy credit floor
overlays.operationsNote: If credit score is below 660, move to alternate investor or improve credit profile before lock.

overlays.title: Investment DTI cap
overlays.operationsNote: Investment occupancy above 45 DTI requires investor exception or program change.

overlays.title: FHA manual underwrite reserves
overlays.operationsNote: Manual underwrite FHA files require at least 3 months reserves at this investor.

overlays.title: VA minimum FICO
overlays.operationsNote: VA files below 620 are ineligible at this investor regardless of residual-income strength.

overlays.title: VA cash-out LTV cap
overlays.operationsNote: Cash-out transactions above 90 LTV require different investor strategy.

overlays.title: USDA credit overlay
overlays.operationsNote: USDA submissions below 640 require alternate investor or exception path.

overlays.title: USDA DTI overlay
overlays.operationsNote: DTI above 46 may require documented compensating factors and investor approval.

overlays.title: High-LTV reserve floor
overlays.operationsNote: High-LTV files are materially more executable with at least 2 months reserves.
